name: voice-tone
title: Voice tone
description: How each stretch of speech in a video is said: how loud against the usual speech of the video, and with which emotion (angry, calm, disgust, fear, happy, neutral, sad, surprise). No language model.

measure.description: How each stretch of speech is said: its loudness against the usual speech of the video (low, normal, loud) and the emotion of the voice. Give the sentences of speech-to-text or the turns of speakers in segments to measure them as they are; with none, the sound is measured in windows.
measure.title: Measure the voice tone

media.title: Video or sound
media.description: The video or sound: a stored file or a video as media.open gives it, or a path in text. Loomas decodes its sound to 16 kHz, one channel.

segments.title: Stretches to measure
segments.description: The stretches of speech to measure, each with startMs and endMs: the sentences of speech-to-text or the turns of speakers, as they are (their other fields are kept). Leave it out to measure the sound in windows.

windowMs.title: Window
windowMs.description: How long each window is when no segments are given (default 3000).

loudDb.title: Loud or low from
loudDb.description: How many dB above the usual speech of the video counts as loud, and below as low (default 6).

emotions.title: Tell the emotion
emotions.description: Tell the emotion of each stretch (default true). Without it only the loudness is measured and no model is downloaded.

device.title: Run on
device.description: Where the emotion model runs: cpu (the default), or gpu / auto, which use the graphics card (on Windows, any DirectX 12 card). A card that cannot be used falls back to the processor; the result says what ran.

segments.title: Stretches
segments.description: The stretches given, with their fields and the tone added, or the windows with speech when none were given. A value that cannot be measured is null.

loudnessDb.title: Level
loudnessDb.description: How loud the speech is, in dB below full scale (pauses between words left out); null for silence.

emotion.title: Emotion
emotion.description: The likeliest emotion; null for silence or a stretch under half a second. Left out when emotions is false.

referenceDb.title: Usual level
referenceDb.description: The middle level of the stretches with speech: what normal is for this video.

device.title: What it ran on
device.description: What the emotion model really ran on: device, name (the graphics card, if one was used) and fallback (why not). Null when it did not run.

failures.description: A param is wrong, a segment has no valid startMs and endMs, or media is missing or not sound Loomas decoded for the plugin.
A file cannot be read or the model cannot be loaded.
The model could not be downloaded (it is fetched once, on first use). Trying again may work.
